info.name: NorthCart API
info.description:
The whole NorthCart API in journey order. Import together with NorthCart.local.postman_environment.json, select the "NorthCart (local)" environment, then Run collection: every request stores what the next one needs (tokens, ids, order number) in collection variables. Needs PAYMENT_PROVIDER=fake.

Interactive docs: {{baseUrl}}/swagger-ui.html

request.description: Creates a CUSTOMER and returns a JWT. The test script stores it in {{customerToken}}.

Same response whether or not the email exists (no account enumeration). Check Mailpit at http://localhost:8025 for the link.
Idempotency-Key: a new UUID per checkout attempt. Re-sending the same key returns the same order (200), never a second one.
